cells.gaps: No source found shows a programme teaching the public digital skills in service with a stated count; the one found is being prepared for Principe island. No survey share of digital skills is held.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13 under ruling 61, which does not ask for a national programme: Principe's regional government and partners started a project in June 2025 that is preparing adult training centres (STP-003), which answers question 1. AGER's November 2025 finding (STP-002) is about the national digital policy and does not say that no programme teaches the public.
